# THORACIC SURGERY POST-OPERATIVE ANTIMICROBIAL PROPHYLAXIS RECOMMENDATIONS

Place post-op IV antimicrobial prophylaxis orders after admission to ward.

Duration of antimicrobial prophylaxis should not exceed 24 hours. Durations

longer than 24 hours have not been shown effective in preventing cardiothoracic

surgical site infections. There is no benefit to continuing antimicrobial

prophylaxis until all indwelling drains and intravascular catheters are removed.

For CIED surgery postoperative antimicrobial prophylaxis click link below:

[CIED Surgery Postoperative Prophylaxis](surg-vascular-surg-postop)

For CV surgery (Open Heart) postoperative prophylaxis click link below:

[CV Surgery Postoperative Prophylaxis](cardiac-surgery-post-op-prophylaxis)

# Esophageal Surgical Procedures Postoperative Prophylaxis

[Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h x 2 doses post-op \($\) R <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV](orz-set-abx-cefazolin-2gm-metronidazole-500mg-2-doses-post-op)

q8h x 2 doses post-op ($) [R]

Alternative for patient with cephalosporin allergy

[Clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h x 2 doses post-op \($$\)](psjizid-clindam-900mg-iv-q8h-x2doses-postop)

Alternative for patient colonized or recently infected with MRSA

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV \(pharmacy to dose\) q12h x 1 dose post-op \($\) R](psjizid-vancomycin-15mg-kg-postoperative-q12h-once)

# Non-Esophageal Thoracic Procedures Postoperative Prophylaxis

Includes video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) and non-cardiac procedures

including lobectomy, pneumonectomy, lung resection and thoracotomy.

No postoperative antibiotic prophylaxis is recommended

References:

Bratzler DW et al, Clinical Practice Guidelines for Antimicrobial Prophylaxis in

Surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm (2013) 70:195-283
